description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Dispute between Ceylon Estate Staff's Union Badulla and other Part Malwatte Valley plantation Plc. Colombo 12
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the appointment of an arbitrator under the Industrial Disputes Act to settle a specific industrial dispute. It references specific legislation (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and contains a legal order made by the Minister under statutory powers. While it mentions a government minister (Manusha Nanayakkara), the core content is about implementing a legal/regulatory framework for dispute resolution rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory procedures and statutory instruments under existing labor legislation.
